title: Phase MC: meeting:tick event + live VU meters missing
description: PLAN Section MC.6 spec'd meeting:tick { elapsed_ms, mic_db, sys_db } emitted from the capture loop for live UI feedback during recording. Only elapsed_ms is reflected (UI-side setInterval substitute in Meetings.tsx); mic_db and sys_db are not computed or emitted anywhere. Result: no live VU meter / audio-level indication during a meeting recording — user cannot tell if their mic is hot or muted until after stop. Fix: in TwinStreamCapture drain loop, compute peak/RMS dBFS per channel per ~50ms tick and emit meeting:tick via the AppHandle. Wire UI subscriber + Pill component to render. Estimated: 1-2 hours.
